hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: Lee2019 participants and pairs of C3/C6/R8-D/E. R8-E (pretrained CBraMod, 20-channel R8 input) outcomes are known; random-initialised CBraMod and the pretraining-format 19-channel input have never been run. Every comparison with R8-E is a new paired contrast on identical pairs.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.question: Did R8-E measure a pretrained foundation model, and does pretraining change the exact-copy effect? R8 compared CBraMod only with other architectures, so 'pretraining does not protect' was not identified.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.B1_rule: masked-patch NMSE (zero predictor = 1). V1: pretrained NMSE on clean pretraining-format input <= 0.90 and <= (best of 3 random initialisations) - 0.10. V2: pretrained NMSE on the R8 input <= 0.90 and <= its NMSE on the pretraining-format input (all trials) + 0.10. CERTIFIED_ENGAGED = V1 and V2; MONTAGE_DEGRADED = V1 and not V2 (=> B3 runs); NOT_ESTABLISHED = not V1 (the pretrained interpretation is downgraded; B3 does not run). 'Clean' = max |x| < 100 uV over the trial (CBraMod's pretraining bad-sample rule).

B2_family_holm.B2_H1_random_final_d: random-initialised CBraMod fine-tuned, final-epoch d != 0 (MC sign-flip)
B2_family_holm.B2_H3_pre_minus_random_es_d: same for the early-stopped (minimum validation loss) epoch
B2_family_holm.B2_H4_pre_minus_random_final_partner_pro: pretrained minus random-initialised partner-arm correct-class probability (decodability) != 0, final epoch

probe_family_holm.P_H1_pre_minus_random_probe_d: pretrained-encoder probe d (R8-E1) minus random-encoder probe d != 0

B3_family_holm_conditional.B3_H1_pre19_final_d: pretrained CBraMod on the 19-channel pretraining-format input, final d != 0

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: random-init: early-stopped d, ES - final, placebo, BA contrast, partner probability, off-target change, early-stopping epochs, A/A, comparisons with EEGNet / ShallowConvNet / TS+LR on the same pairs; reproduction of R8-E2 / R8-E1 pretrained d on the same pairs; B1 NMSE for every input x model, unmasked NMSE, channel-permuted R8 input
interpretation_rules: a non-significant pretrained-random difference is reported with its CI and is not equivalence
R8's 'pretraining does not protect' wording is replaced by the B2 result whatever it is
if B1 is NOT_ESTABLISHED, R8-E is described as 'CBraMod architecture initialised from the released checkpoint', not as evidence about pretrained representations
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region; all results reported whatever their sign

design.B1: forward passes only on all 21,600 trials; inputs: R8 20-channel (official downstream preprocessing), the same with a fixed channel permutation (seed 9301), and the 19-channel pretraining-format build; Bernoulli(0.5) patch masks from torch CPU generator seed 9302 (one mask per input shape, shared by all models); models: TUEG checkpoint, random initialisations with seeds 0, 1, 2 (pretraining reconstruction head kept); eval mode
design.B2: R8-D/E subset plan (216 pairs, arms A, B, C, E, A/A), identical recipe, seeds and read-outs to R8-E2; the only change is that the backbone keeps its random initialisation (torch.manual_seed(init_seed) before construction, as R8)
design.B2_probe: frozen backbone constructed after torch.manual_seed(0) (R8-E1's construction seed) without loading the checkpoint; avg-pooled 200-d embedding; exact probe as R8-E1 on all 8,640 C3 pairs
design.B3: identical to R8-E2 / R8-E1 except the 19-channel pretraining-format input (head width 19 x 4 x 200)
